name: vestigial like family member 2
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: VGLL2 encodes transcription cofactor vestigial-like protein 2. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

function.text: VGLL2 encodes transcription cofactor vestigial-like protein 2. It may act as a specific coactivator for the mammalian TEFs. May play a role in the development of skeletal muscles.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving VGLL2 have been reported in rhabdomyosarcoma.
